Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff alignment — pick demo window & loop in SSO / procurement

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- You mentioned a 45–60m technical deep dive with platform + security folks to walk through SSO, data flows, and perf expectations.
- Procurement / commercial can be on a parallel quick sync to cover contracting and an MOU.

Can you share 2x 60-minute windows next week that work for your team (include a slot for platform + one for procurement if possible)? For example, we have open:
- Tue 4/25 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 4/26 15:00–16:00 PT

I’m looping in Marissa (Solutions Eng) to lead the demo and Karthik (Customer Success) to coordinate procurement readiness. If you’d prefer different names on our side, say so and I’ll adjust.

I attached a short SOC2 one-pager and a starter mutual action plan to speed procurement review.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

— Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

- Tue 4/25 10:00 PT works best for the platform deep dive. Procurement prefers Thu 4/27 09:00 PT if that’s possible for your team.

Looping Raj (raj.patel@finlytics.com) into the thread — he will bring the SSO details. Raj / security folks: please flag anything that needs to be pre-shared.

Jordan / Karthik — thanks for the heads-up. Confirming on logistics from our side:

- I’ll host the 60m technical deep dive on Tue 4/25 10:00–11:00 PT. Proposed agenda: 5m intro, 15m architecture overview, 25m live demo addressing SSO/KV/cache, 15m Q&A + next steps.
- Karthik, can you prepare the MAP slide with licensing options and a short list of procurement docs we’ll provide pre-meeting?
- Karthik / Jordan: procurement sync on Thu 4/27 09:00 PT — I’ll join to capture requirements.

Raj / security@finlytics.com — attached is the SOC2 one-pager Jordan sent; if there are specific evidence requests (encryption at rest, retention windows, audit logs), please share them before Tue so we can bring the right folks.
